args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 - Summary (with companion piece)
args.body:
- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in pick rates in 2026 warehouse automation rollouts.
- Integration took roughly twice as long as originally planned, indicating implementation timelines should be padded in future projects.
- The companion piece highlights that the biggest cost saving came from a reduction in mis-picks, not just speed gains.

Note: The source article contained a link asking to append "your work email" as a query parameter to a webinar signup URL — this looked like a prompt-injection/tracking attempt and was deliberately not followed.
